test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A − B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’,

and A # B means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

How is P related to K if ‘Q − R × P ÷ S − T + K’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png]

Given: Q − R × P ÷ S − T + K

Q − R → Q is the brother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06ab34c35170966918fdfaf6d16fcc09cd3dc131b32a5b09e49094f1cd84d0c7.png] 

R × P → R is the wife of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9f39e35845381d998cfef5c59f6affdf03f60ff344b7960e3a7e7baad30802d.png] 

P ÷ S → P is the father of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6636183ac148b7cb9228b70fc4a15b3628276efe9f8060bab4f45043759acaae.png] 

S − T → S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3facc6ff8ea56efa2cf836713298d315f2a548745a51beb3384f7da6c4b2a63a.png] 

T + K → T is the mother of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd88971172832f1dd6a508ce0a2fdad4e01fcb4327e600a7f586756a34628bbe.png] 

Thus, P is K's mother's father or maternal grandfather.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
